$comment: Pacenotes' CI contract (scripts/affected.mjs, .gitea/actions/app-gates, ADR 0014 §6; the field list is in .gitea/actions/README.md): a leg of ci.yml on Linux for its Cargo workspace (fmt, clippy, nextest, doc tests, deny). Stage 1 of the first-release plan holds pure crates only (no Tauri, no UI), so there is no ui, e2e or host leg yet; they come with the app skeleton (stage 2, D0). The checks are the cargo-metadata guard (ADR 0022 §3.7; see apps/pacenotes/scripts/check-no-cargo-metadata.mjs: the real guard is `cargo tree -e features`, conformance C52 is the backstop that reads the manifests) and their tests. The coverage gate (99% lines of product code) runs on main and the nightly only: the gates' nextest already runs every test on a branch, and a second run under llvm-cov would run them twice (rule 50). pacenotes-parse and pacenotes-index are gated at 95% lines, not 99% (parse measures 97.05%, index 95.6%). What no test reaches: the ABI refusal, `set_language` failure and `NoTree` in parse (no grammar outside the runtime's range exists; the parser returns no tree only when stopped); `?` early returns on a tree-sitter node that lacks a field its table names (the tables test fails first); and, in index, every `map_err(db)?` / `map_err(read_error)?` arm that only fires when SQLite itself fails (disk full, I/O error), the file-system error arms of `DiskFs`, and the failure arms of assert macros in tests.
rustChecks: if [ "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" = main ] || [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = schedule ]; then cargo llvm-cov nextest -p pacenotes-core -p pacenotes-function-api -p pacenotes-git --profile ci --summary-only --ignore-filename-regex 'contract\.rs|wire_tests\.rs' --fail-under-lines 99; cargo llvm-cov nextest -p pacenotes-parse -p pacenotes-index --profile ci --summary-only --ignore-filename-regex 'contract\.rs|wire_tests\.rs' --fail-under-lines 95; else echo 'coverage gate runs on main and the nightly, not on branches (rule 50); the leg already ran every test'; fi
